description:
Concentration, up to 10 minutes.

You command all the insects around you to swarm an area you choose. Choose a point within Long Range. The insects form a swarm that radiates out to Short Range in all directions from that point. The area within the swarm is Difficult Terrain.

Roll Spirit. The result becomes the spell's Difficulty. Any time a creature enters or begins its turn within the swarm, it must roll Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a failure, it takes 4d10 damage. On a pass, half damage.
name: Swarm
successes:
✨: +1d damage.

🌞: Each time you sustain Concentration for this spell, you may shift the swarm 10 ft in any direction you choose.
